title: Relieving Letter vs Experience Letter: Differences, Formats and What to Do If HR Refuses
seoTitle: Relieving Letter vs Experience Letter: Key Differences
seoDescription: A relieving letter confirms your exit date; an experience letter records your role and tenure. What 2026 rules say, substitutes, and steps if HR refuses.
excerpt: A side-by-side table, what the 2026 model standing orders actually require, the documents new employers accept when the letter is stuck, sample request wording and the escalation steps.
